FULL SCREEN ON IPHONE: ADD BELT COMMAND TO YOUR HOME SCREEN
1 TAP SHARE
2 ADD TO HOME SCREEN
3 OPEN IT FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
PLAY IN SAFARI INSTEAD (NOT FULL SCREEN)
KEYBOARD + MOUSE: the mouse points, WASD or arrows scroll the map, click or SPACE to build, click the icons (or Q/E, 1-0) to choose, U upgrade, hold R recycle, right-click ping, wheel zoom, TAB map, ESC pause. Menus work with the mouse too.
GAMEPADS: plug in up to 4 and press A on each to join. Split screen on one display.
 TOUCH: drag to move, pinch to zoom, tap an icon then tap the map to place it, tap again to build. Tap a structure to upgrade or recycle.
TURN YOUR PHONE SIDEWAYS
BELT COMMAND PLAYS IN LANDSCAPE
